name: Dark Fantasy Bourbon Biscuit
ingredients: MAIDA (REFINED WHEAT FLOUR), SUGAR (35.0%), REFINED PALM OIL, COLOURS (150a, 150c, 150d, 129), STARCH, COCOA SOLIDS (1.8%), RAISING AGENTS [503(ii), 500(ii), 450(i)], ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA, CHOCOLATE), EMULSIFIERS [MONO AND DIGLYCERIDES OF FATTY ACIDS (FROM PALM OIL), LECITHIN (SOY), POLYSORBATE 60 (FROM PALM)], IODIZED SALT, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CHOCOLATE), PLAIN CHOCOLATE (0.01%).
